series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a strong upward trend with significant seasonality. Concept drift and unstable rankings across models suggest a weighted combination approach with dynamic error adaptation is appropriate to account for changing model performance and avoid over-reliance on any single model.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.6: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift suggests dynamic error weighting (ADE) is appropriate to adapt to changing model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.method_hint=ade_dynamic_error AND series_profile.recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → aligns with recommended shrinkage and weighted combination approach
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures different model performance across forecast horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
